comment: Languages of the layout model, in model order. id: input pack id; language_id: Windows layout language (LANGID, hex) as exported by export_layouts.ps1; layout: the exact Windows layout (KLID); frequency: 'wordfreq:CODE' or 'file:NAME' (a 'word count' list in the sources directory); sha256 and source: the reviewed file and how its notice names it; share: how often generated sentences use it as the main language; dictionary: main and short word lists relative to the dictionary directory. wordfreq: the wordfreq version the wordfreq: sources and the noise come from. noise: wordfreq codes of other languages whose words, typed on noise_layout, must stay unchanged.
